Class InventoryRepository

java.lang.Object
com.squad93.pos.db.InventoryRepository
public final class InventoryRepository extends Object
Inventory operations; each mutation is a single atomic PostgreSQL statement.

  • Method Details

    • restockLowStock

      public int restockLowStock() throws IOException, SQLException
      Atomically refills every item below its saved minimum to its current target. Uses database values at execution time so concurrent stock changes are not overwritten by a stale snapshot.
      Returns:
      the number of inventory rows refilled
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if a database operation fails

    • listAll

      public List<InventoryRepository.InventoryItem> listAll() throws IOException, SQLException
      Loads all inventory, including supplies and items without stock.
      Returns:
      an immutable list ordered by inventory identifier
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if a database operation fails

    • add

      public InventoryRepository.InventoryItem add(String ingredientName, String unit, BigDecimal quantityOnHand, BigDecimal targetFillLevel, BigDecimal minimumStock) throws IOException, SQLException
      Creates an inventory item that is not offered as an extra topping.
      Parameters:
      ingredientName - nonblank name of at most 120 characters
      unit - nonblank unit of at most 50 characters
      quantityOnHand - nonnegative initial stock
      targetFillLevel - nonnegative refill target
      minimumStock - nonnegative low-stock threshold no greater than the target
      Returns:
      the saved inventory item with its generated identifier
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if a database operation fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if text, quantities, or the minimum-to-target relationship are invalid

    • add

      public InventoryRepository.InventoryItem add(String ingredientName, String unit, BigDecimal quantityOnHand, BigDecimal targetFillLevel, BigDecimal minimumStock, boolean topping, BigDecimal toppingPrice) throws IOException, SQLException
      Creates inventory with an optional extra-topping designation and price.
      Parameters:
      ingredientName - nonblank name of at most 120 characters
      unit - nonblank unit of at most 50 characters
      quantityOnHand - nonnegative initial stock
      targetFillLevel - nonnegative refill target
      minimumStock - nonnegative low-stock threshold no greater than the target
      topping - whether to offer this item as an extra topping
      toppingPrice - nonnegative price for a topping; must be null otherwise
      Returns:
      the saved inventory item with its generated identifier
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if a database operation fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if text, quantities, minimum stock, or topping settings are invalid

    • adjustQuantity

      public InventoryRepository.InventoryItem adjustQuantity(int inventoryId, BigDecimal delta) throws IOException, SQLException
      Adds a signed stock adjustment without replacing concurrent checkout deductions. The update fails if the resulting stock would be negative.
      Parameters:
      inventoryId - positive identifier of the inventory item
      delta - signed quantity to add, with at most three fractional digits
      Returns:
      the inventory item after adjustment
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if the item is missing, stock would become negative, or the update fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the identifier or adjustment is invalid

    • setQuantity

      public InventoryRepository.InventoryItem setQuantity(int inventoryId, BigDecimal expectedQuantity, BigDecimal newQuantity) throws IOException, SQLException
      Sets an absolute quantity only when the stored stock still matches the displayed value.
      Parameters:
      inventoryId - positive identifier of the inventory item
      expectedQuantity - nonnegative quantity loaded by the caller
      newQuantity - nonnegative replacement quantity
      Returns:
      the inventory item after the successful comparison and update
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if the item is missing, its stock changed, or the update fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the identifier or quantities are invalid

    • update

      public InventoryRepository.InventoryItem update(int inventoryId, String name, BigDecimal expectedQuantity, BigDecimal newQuantity, BigDecimal targetFillLevel, BigDecimal minimumStock, boolean topping, BigDecimal toppingPrice) throws IOException, SQLException
      Saves inventory details and quantity together while preserving the recipe unit. Rejects a stale stock snapshot rather than overwriting a concurrent checkout deduction.
      Parameters:
      inventoryId - positive identifier of the inventory item
      name - nonblank name of at most 120 characters
      expectedQuantity - stock value originally loaded by the caller
      newQuantity - nonnegative replacement stock
      targetFillLevel - nonnegative refill target
      minimumStock - nonnegative alert threshold no greater than the target
      topping - whether to offer this item as an extra topping
      toppingPrice - nonnegative extra-serving price for a topping; null otherwise
      Returns:
      the updated inventory snapshot
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if the item is missing, its stock changed, or the update fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if any identifier, text, quantity, or topping setting is invalid
